Wiki Main Page

By the way! Everything in the folder "wiki" will automatically be tagged with the layout "wiki" and be added to the collection "wiki", unless you override it. See this page's header for an example of overriding. So you can make as many folders in here as you want and it'll all be tagged for you. To tag for series, you can either manually tag (example on prowl.md), or create a folder for the series and a json tagger (example in the other folders). As always, you can mix-and-match in case you want something tagged with multiple series!

The "no photo" is automatically applied if there is no "main image" assigned to a page. You can change what this asset looks like by replacing /assets/no-img-default.jpg
